# Install the Widget CLI

The Widget CLI talks to your Widget account from the terminal. Setting it up takes three steps.

## Install it

```bash
npm install -g @widget/cli
```

Run `widget --version`. It prints `widget 4.` and a minor version.

## Sign in

```bash
widget login
```

This opens a browser window where you sign in to your Widget account. When it's done, `widget whoami` prints your account's email address.

## Create a project

```bash
widget init my-project
```

Afterwards, `my-project/widget.json` exists.

## If something goes wrong

### `widget: command not found`

npm's global `bin` directory isn't on your `PATH`. Run `npm prefix -g`, and add the `bin` directory under it to your `PATH`.

### `widget login` says the browser couldn't be opened

Run `widget login --no-browser` and open the URL it prints yourself.
